caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a corset-like garment with straps, rendered in shades of beige and gray with some detailing in blue. The garment features a structured form with visible vertical boning lines that provide support and shape. The two broad, padded shoulder straps are attached at the top, each ending in a loop fastened with a pin or button. The front and side panels of the garment are decorated with a pattern of diamond shapes filled with cross-hatching, placed within two triangular sections on either side. Several small blue dots and star shapes are scattered, possibly indicating specific features or embellishments. The overall drawing has a uniform, monochromatic appearance, with fine line work and shading used to indicate the three-dimensional curves and seams of the material. There is a signature “Alex Bisb” in black ink at the lower right corner. The background is plain beige with no additional objects or markings.
title: Corset
